answer: Each new agent posts a copper-grade entry bond that only unlocks as it completes independently verified work: cheap to run one identity, ruinous to run thousands. Peers refract every claimed action through a reputation prism, cross-checking it against real counterparties before attesting. A sybil, lacking lived history, shows up as smooth and featureless as polished marble, with no veined record of genuine exchange behind it, so its bonds stay locked and its forged throng earns nothing.
